stories.title: Rucha Attal moves from Sangli to Paris Fashion Week
stories.summary: Rucha Attal, a beauty pageant winner and entrepreneur, has transitioned from the streets of Sangli to the runways of Paris Fashion Week 2026. Attal gained recognition after securing the 3rd Runner-Up position at The International Glamour Project Miss India 2025, Season 4, representing the state of Maharashtra.

stories.title: Nitanshi Goel walks for Suneet Varma at Lakme Fashion Week
stories.summary: Actress Nitanshi Goel served as the showstopper for Suneet Varma at Lakme Fashion Week 2026 in New Delhi. She wore an embellished fishtail lehenga from the designer’s Kashi collection, which is inspired by the city’s heritage and craftsmanship. The collection focuses on traditional colours and local artisan techniques.

stories.title: Bhai Dooj 2026 Fashion Trends Inspired By Celebrity Festive Looks - Outlook Luxe
stories.summary: Bhai Dooj brings with it another opportunity to dress up, gather around the family, exchange gifts and carry the festive spirit into one more celebration. Whether the occasion calls for a traditional puja at home, an elaborate family lunch or an intimate get-together, choosing an

stories.title: Senco Gold launches AI app for jewellery selection
stories.summary: Kolkata-based Senco Gold has launched an AI app called Shape of You to assist customers in selecting jewellery. The app recommends designs based on a user’s face structure. The jeweller says the technology helps preserve traditions while staying modern for customers like the local Lahiri family.

stories.title: Sockscarving founders start brand with 40,000 rupees
stories.summary: Three friends founded Sockscarving to provide design-led socks for Gen Z consumers. The company began with an initial capital of 40,000 rupees after the founders explored dropshipping. The brand aims to tap into a fashion landscape where consumers increasingly seek products that reflect their individual style and personality.

stories.title: The Souled Store reaches 105 outlets in Pune
stories.summary: The Souled Store has expanded its retail network to 105 outlets with a new location in Viman Nagar, Pune. The brand sells licensed merchandise, pop culture-inspired products and everyday fashion. The company continues to increase its physical retail footprint across India to reach more offline shoppers.

stories.summary: Chandigarh: In a move to align skill training with industry requirements, Punjab Skill Development Mission (PSDM) has signed memorandums of understanding (MoUs) with State Institute of Automotive and Driving Skills (SIADS), Mahuana, and entered into a tripartite agreement involving Northern India Institute of Fashion Technology

stories.title: Three Prada Obsessives Unpack Miuccia’s Defining Decade
stories.summary: Prada is as much an adjective as it is a noun. My colleagues and I often describe wardrobe twists, like a bejeweled brooch on a Peter Pan collar or an embroidered sock peeking out of a Mary Jane, as “very Prada.” But what is it

stories.summary: Someone phone all the '90s supermodels, because Zara's new holiday collection has me ready to cancel my sensible family plans and find somewhere fabulous to be seen. This season, the retailer is taking a nostalgic approach to party dressing, trading predictable holiday sparkle for the

stories.title: Louis Vuitton appoints Hector Muelas as creative chief
stories.summary: Louis Vuitton has appointed Hector Muelas as chief brand creative officer, a newly created position. The move follows a 5 per cent quarterly revenue drop in LVMH’s fashion division and a trademark dispute in China. Muelas previously directed brand strategy at Rimowa and creative operations at Tiffany and Co.

stories.title: Mckenna Grace wears Hunger Games-inspired gown
stories.summary: Actress Mckenna Grace wore a custom Elisabetta Franchi gown to a screening of The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping. The dress was designed to recreate Katniss Everdeen’s iconic Capitol Party outfit from the film Catching Fire. The event featured a recreation of the movie’s Cornucopia set.

stories.title: Nicole Richie named muse for Balenciaga Le City bag
stories.summary: Balenciaga has named Nicole Richie the muse for its Le City bag to celebrate the product’s 25th anniversary. The brand is leaning into the early aughts aesthetic, citing Richie’s frequent street-style appearances with the bag as a primary driver for its original popularity in the fashion industry.

stories.title: The Women at the Helm of Fashion | Metal Magazine
stories.summary: Following the announcement of Martine Rose as Balenciaga’s new creative director, there has never been a better time to take a closer look at the women leading some of fashion’s biggest houses. Despite their undeniable talent and creative achievements, women remain a minority in the

stories.title: Celebrities debut contrasting styles at LACMA gala
stories.summary: Kim Kardashian, Nicole Kidman and Paris Hilton showcased different approaches to evening wear at the 2026 LACMA Art and Film Gala. Kardashian wore a burgundy Gucci gown, Kidman opted for Chanel, and Hilton chose an embellished Jenny Packham dress. The event remains a major Hollywood fashion fundraiser.

stories.title: From Tang jackets to vinyl coats, the fall 2026 trends to know now

stories.title: Titan bets on studded jewellery and premium watches
stories.summary: Titan expects future earnings growth from its studded jewellery segment, which now accounts for 35% of sales. The company is also focusing on premium watches and engineering services. While gold prices remain volatile, Titan plans to promote affordable 18K and 14K collections to keep customers in stores.

stories.title: Bejeweled Ball displays $270 million in high jewellery
stories.summary: Neiman Marcus and Saks Fifth Avenue hosted the fourth annual Bejeweled Ball in Santa Monica on November 5. The event showcased more than 1,600 high jewellery pieces and rare timepieces from seven houses, valued at over $270 million. Guests were invited to meet the designers on the terrace.

stories.title: France and Botswana sign natural diamond declaration
stories.summary: France and Botswana signed the Paris Declaration on Natural Diamonds to promote consistent terminology. The agreement states that the word diamond should refer specifically to natural stones. The move aims to strengthen consumer trust and protect the integrity of natural diamonds, according to the two governments.

stories.title: Botswana and France ink natural diamond agreement
stories.summary: Botswana and France signed the Paris Declaration at the Paris Peace Forum to promote responsible growth in the natural diamond sector. The agreement coincides with the 60th anniversary of Botswana's independence and diplomatic relations between the two nations. The deal aims to strengthen consumer confidence in natural stones.

stories.title: Kalyan Jewellers reports 64% profit jump
stories.summary: Kalyan Jewellers reported a 63.9% increase in consolidated net profit to ₹427.1 crore for Q2 FY27. Revenue rose 31.4% to ₹10,322.6 crore. The profit figure includes a ₹73.46 crore exceptional gain from the sale of investment property. Growth was supported by domestic retail demand and international operations.

stories.title: GIA identifies lab-grown diamond modified to look natural
stories.summary: The GIA examined a 6.06-carat CVD-grown pink diamond that was modified to mimic a natural rough stone. The lab reported the stone featured etched trigons and rounded faces typically associated with natural crystals. The fancy pink colour was reportedly achieved through a multi-step treatment process.

stories.title: Tiffany & Co. and CFDA name jewellery design finalists
stories.summary: Tiffany & Co. and the Council of Fashion Designers of America selected five finalists for their 2026-27 jewellery designer program. The initiative pairs emerging talent with creative mentorship and a design challenge based on the house's heritage. Finalists will develop interpretations of Tiffany's design codes for a committee.

stories.title: Kalyan Jewellers revenue rises 31% in second quarter
stories.summary: Kalyan Jewellers reported consolidated revenue of ₹10,323 crore for Q2 FY27, up from ₹7,856 crore a year earlier. EBITDA rose 29.7% to ₹644.7 crore, though margins moderated slightly to 6.25%. The company's India operations accounted for ₹9,007 crore of the total revenue reported for the quarter.

stories.title: Jewellery industry looks to wedding season after Dhanteras
stories.summary: The jewellery industry reported Dhanteras sales matching last year's levels, providing a boost to sentiment before the wedding season. High gold prices continue to influence consumer purchasing habits. The Gems and Jewellery Council expects easing global and political uncertainties to further support consumer sentiment in coming months.

stories.title: Oura to acquire Counsel Health
stories.summary: Smart ring maker Oura has announced plans to acquire Counsel Health for $625 million. The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Bose earbuds receive diamond-studded makeover
stories.summary: Bose and Cece Jewellery have collaborated on a one-of-a-kind version of the Ultra Open Earbuds. The design features a winged pink heart and a diamond-studded gold background. The earbuds are housed in an 18-carat gold bag, which the brand describes as blurring the lines between art and technology.

stories.title: Papier expands into fashion accessories
stories.summary: Stationery brand Papier has entered the fashion accessories market. The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Tyler, The Creator and Converse release new collection
stories.summary: Converse and Tyler, The Creator have unveiled the Bronco Boot Low as part of their 1908 collection. The release includes new suede iterations of the Pro Leather and Jogger silhouettes. The collection will be available on November 12 through Converse and GOLF le FLEUR channels.

stories.title: Supreme and Timberland release Bandana Field Boot
stories.summary: Supreme and Timberland have partnered for a collaborative Bandana Field Boot for Fall 2026. The boot features a printed waterproof nubuck upper and padded leather collar. It will be available in three colorways starting November 12, with an Asia release scheduled for November 14.

stories.title: Heelys launches Sonic the Hedgehog footwear collection
stories.summary: Heelys has partnered with SEGA to release a limited-edition footwear collection inspired by Sonic the Hedgehog. The range features two designs based on the characters Sonic and Amy Rose, incorporating specific colour schemes and design elements from the franchise. The collection is available in the Gio silhouette.

stories.title: G-SHOCK hosts launch event in Singapore
stories.summary: G-SHOCK launched the GMC-2500 and GAC-2500 watches at Singapore's IMBA Theatre on November 7. The event featured a history wall tracing the lineage of the 2500 series from the original DW-5000C. The new models feature fully analog faces and are marketed under the theme of toughness.

stories.title: Razer releases wired Hammerhead V3 Chroma earbuds
stories.summary: Razer has launched the Hammerhead V3 Chroma, a pair of wired USB-C gaming earbuds featuring dual-driver audio and RGB lighting. The device includes an 11mm dynamic driver, a 6mm tweeter and active noise cancellation. The earbuds are available now for $79.99, marking a return to wired audio hardware.

stories.title: PM Modi promotes National Handloom Day
stories.summary: Prime Minister Modi has called on the public to celebrate National Handloom Day. The initiative encourages citizens to showcase India's handloom heritage. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Shilp Samagam Mela records sales of 64.52 lakh
stories.summary: The 15 day Shilp Samagam Mela 2026 at Dilli Haat has recorded sales exceeding 64.52 lakh. Organised by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, the event provides a platform for artisans from marginalised communities to market their products. The fair remains open until 15 November.

stories.title: School of Fashion bins aim to cut waste
stories.summary: The Sustainable Fashion Initiative introduced fabric waste bins to six classrooms at Toronto Metropolitan University in 2022. The group aims to reduce waste in an industry it describes as often wasteful. Students are now sorting scraps to keep them out of the landfill.

stories.title: Monaghan lace artisans complete 4,300 hour project
stories.summary: Lace artisans from Monaghan have finished a fashion design project requiring 4,300 hours of handiwork. The piece is described as a spectacular design. The full details of the project are available to subscribers of the Irish Independent.

stories.title: Motilal Oswal textile stock analysis
stories.summary: The Financial Express reports that Motilal Oswal sees a 46 per cent upside in a textile stock priced under 1,000. The full article is currently unavailable due to a server configuration error. The website owner has been advised to check their CloudFront documentation.

stories.title: New rules for Cambodia garment exports
stories.summary: Cambodia is implementing five new rules for garment exporters, including tighter origin checks on imported fabrics. Exports reached approximately 9.23 billion in the first nine months of 2026. Penalties for repeat offences now include licence revocation. Compliance is becoming a central requirement for factory operators.

stories.title: Tunisia workwear exports face decline
stories.summary: Tunisia remains the top non-bloc workwear supplier to the EU, beating China by 5 million. However, official exports and factory numbers are falling. The country is now targeting technical textiles to offset the decline. The industry is currently navigating an uneven shift in production.

stories.title: Egypt increases export support for textiles
stories.summary: Egypt has approved a 35 per cent average increase in export support for garments and textiles. While apparel exports rose to 3.4 billion in the first nine months of 2026, the supply chain remains split. Freight rules and payment speeds may determine the policy's actual impact.

stories.title: Bangladesh garment exports to new markets rise
stories.summary: Bangladesh readymade garment exports to non-traditional and emerging markets grew by 9.3 per cent year-on-year during the first four months of the 2027 fiscal year. The growth reflects a shift in export destinations for the country's manufacturers.

stories.title: Thrifting growth sparks sustainability debate
stories.summary: Second-hand shopping is growing 2.5 times faster among Gen Z than other age groups, according to ThredUP. Some students at Toronto Metropolitan University suggest the trend may be falling victim to the same overconsumption it promises to solve. Finding a military petticoat remains a priority.

stories.title: Designer explores mycelium for textile waste
stories.summary: Narishdath Maraj, a graduate of Toronto Metropolitan University, is working on research to repurpose natural fibre textile waste into biodegradable, mycelium-based materials. As creative director at Mpolo Designs, he focuses on reducing waste by helping people understand the potential value of discarded materials.

stories.title: Inditex commits 50 million to green supplier fund
stories.summary: Inditex has committed 50 million to a 400 million fund led by the International Finance Corporation. The initiative provides low-cost loans to help small suppliers transition to net-zero business models. The textile industry is estimated to account for 8 per cent of global greenhouse gas emissions.

stories.title: Transcend focuses on circular textile production
stories.summary: Seattle-based Transcend says beautiful clothing is only the beginning of its mission. The company reclaims vintage and surplus textiles to create its collections. It claims to build meaningful relationships between materials, makers, and markets while relying on natural fibres like silk, wool, and cashmere.

stories.title: Baukjen group maintains high B Corp score
stories.summary: The House of Baukjen holds a B Corp score of 153.6, citing a focus on longevity over trend-led pieces. The group won a 2021 UN Global Climate Action Award for its efforts to remain climate neutral. The company continues to market versatile wardrobe staples.

stories.title: Inditex backs 400 million decarbonisation fund
stories.summary: Inditex is supporting a 400 million fund aimed at decarbonising fashion supply chains. The initiative seeks to provide financial support for suppliers to adopt greener business models. The full report on the funding structure is available to subscribers of The Business of Fashion.

stories.title: Circulose appoints interim CEO
stories.summary: Circulose has appointed an interim CEO as its textile recycling plant restarts operations. The company is working to resume its production of recycled materials. Further details regarding the leadership transition are available to subscribers of The Business of Fashion.

stories.title: GEF fund targets fashion factory energy use
stories.summary: A new fund will provide loans to textile and footwear factories for energy efficiency and water use improvements. Inditex and the IFC are anchor investors. A grant will also assist factories in managing hazardous chemicals. The fund aims to lighten the industry's environmental footprint.

stories.title: IFC targets 400 million for supply chain emissions
stories.summary: The International Finance Corporation is targeting a 400 million fund to reduce fashion supply chain emissions, with backing from Zara owner Inditex. The project aims to transition suppliers to cleaner energy. The full details are available to subscribers of Dealroom.

stories.title: Indian garment makers reduce US market reliance
stories.summary: Orient Craft has reduced shipments to the US following tariff hikes that reached 50 per cent last year. Founder Sudhir Dhingra stated that relying on a single market is too risky. The company is now reconfiguring its export strategy to avoid future trade uncertainty.

stories.title: Fashion prices remain elevated as inflation persists
stories.summary: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported a 0.4 percent rise in the Consumer Price Index for October. While apparel saw a slight contraction in growth to 0.1 percent, overall inflation continues to exceed economist projections. Heightened prices are not going away.

stories.title: Justin Boxford reportedly tapped to lead Capri Holdings
stories.summary: Sources suggest Justin Boxford is preparing to replace John Idol as CEO of Capri Holdings. Boxford recently stepped down as global president of luxury beauty brands at Estée Lauder. The transition follows Idol’s tenure leading the company since 2003. A spokesperson for Capri could not be reached.

stories.summary: Enable JavaScript and cookies to continue Tod’s Creative Director Matteo Tamburini Steps Down The Business of Fashion The full piece is for subscribers, and the headline is all that is public for now.

stories.title: The Children’s Place owes suppliers millions in bankruptcy
stories.summary: The Children’s Place owes tens of millions of dollars to apparel manufacturers while navigating Chapter 11 bankruptcy. Hansae holds a $15.4 million claim against the retailer, followed by millions owed to J.D. United Trading and TNG Investment. The company is currently seeking to sell its assets.

stories.title: World Collective launches platform for small-brand sourcing
stories.summary: World Collective has introduced a portal allowing smaller fashion brands to pool orders for next-gen materials. The platform aims to provide access to suppliers typically reserved for major industry players. The company says it wants to make the sourcing process more accessible and inclusive.

stories.summary: Enable JavaScript and cookies to continue Sneaker Brand On Lifts Profit Outlook on Strong Demand, Tariff Refunds The Business of Fashion The full piece is for subscribers, and the headline is all that is public for now.

stories.title: WEARFITS.me offers AI-generated studio shots from selfies
stories.summary: WEARFITS has launched a tool that generates studio-style product imagery using a user's selfie and measurements. CEO Lukasz Rzepecki says the company aims to avoid the common practice of pasting garments onto full-body photos. The service provides free integration for retailers.

stories.title: Apparel industry turns to AI agents for supply chain management
stories.summary: The retail apparel and textile industry is increasingly adopting AI agents for product expansion and order management. Companies including Sendero Provisions and Blue Yonder are integrating these tools to coordinate supply chain transactions. First Insight is now embedding its technology into AI assistants like ChatGPT.

stories.title: The Outside View: How New AI Oversight Could Ripple Into Retail

stories.title: Who What Wear reports double-digit revenue growth
stories.summary: Fashion publisher Who What Wear saw double-digit revenue growth in fiscal 2026. The company attributes the performance to its AI-driven product, Future Optic, alongside branded social video and events. Roughly half of the publisher's recent campaigns have utilized its AI tools.

stories.title: Immersive Virtual Reality Shapes Consumer Information Processing in Fashion
stories.summary: Immersive virtual reality environments do not uniformly enhance consumer evaluations across retail goods, but instead trigger distinct cognitive processing routes that depend directly on product characteristics and shopping motivations. In a laboratory-based investigation published in Fashion and Textiles, researchers Juyeun Jang and Ho Jung Choo

stories.summary: GORE-TEX is everywhere in fashion right now, but the company told me why it won't work with just anyone When you buy through links on our articles, Future and its syndication partners may earn a commission. There was a time when seeing a GORE-TEX logo

stories.title: Google Photos expands AI styling tool to new regions
stories.summary: Google has expanded its virtual closet feature to users in the U.S., Brazil, and India. The tool uses computer vision and generative AI to categorize garments from a user's photo library. Google says the system turns the fictional wardrobe concept from the 1995 film Clueless into reality.

stories.title: Amazon plans AI agent rollout for Indian sellers
stories.summary: Amazon is preparing to introduce AI agents for its 2 million sellers in India to identify business opportunities. The company describes the shift as the next step for its marketplace. Leadership aims to position the platform as a long-term growth partner for small businesses.

stories.title: CFDA and Google open applications for fashion fellowship
stories.summary: The CFDA and Google are accepting applications for their third annual fashion fellowship through November 24. Five selected brands will receive monetary grants and mentorship from Google product experts. The program concludes with support for the designers' collections at New York Fashion Week in 2027.

stories.title: Birmingham City University offers bursaries for creative degrees
stories.summary: Birmingham City University has introduced £500 bursaries for undergraduate students in design and public service for the 2026/27 academic year. Funded by the George Fentham Opportunity Fund, the initiative aims to lower socio-economic entry barriers for creative and community-focused degrees. Costs are now officially offset.

stories.title: Global Fashion Agenda opens applications for 2027 programme
stories.summary: Global Fashion Agenda and PDS Ventures have opened applications for the Trailblazer Programme 2027. The initiative aims to discover and nurture innovative companies across the fashion supply chain. After a comprehensive evaluation, the jury will select nine finalists from eighteen innovations. The industry is being invited to innovate.

stories.title: FASHION by Informa releases U.S. market playbook
stories.summary: FASHION by Informa has launched a new playbook intended to help international brands enter and scale within the U.S. market. The full piece is for subscribers. The market remains available for entry.

stories.title: High schooler enters beauty industry
stories.summary: A high school student has begun developing products as a beauty inventor with external support. The full piece is for subscribers. Innovation is apparently not restricted by a graduation date.

stories.title: Source Fashion returns to London with expanded manufacturing list
stories.summary: Source Fashion returns to ExCeL London from 19 to 21 January 2027 with manufacturers from more than 20 countries. The event focuses on helping brands reassess supply chains and explore new production partnerships. Bangladesh and Pakistan are noted as areas of growth for the sourcing event.

stories.title: Music, Fashion, & Arts Foundation hosts inaugural ball
stories.summary: The Music, Fashion, & Arts Foundation is hosting its first Creator’s Ball this Saturday in Chattanooga. The black-tie masquerade fundraiser honors local creative community members. The foundation was chartered as a 501c-3 organization in 2021, emerging from the local 423 Days initiative. The city is being celebrated.

stories.title: Pearl Global reports record half-year revenue
stories.summary: Pearl Global Industries reported consolidated revenue of Rs 3,330 crore for H1FY27, a 31.1 percent increase year-on-year. Net profit rose 63.6 percent to Rs 225 crore, while EBITDA margins improved by 120 basis points. The company described the results as its highest quarterly revenue to date.

stories.title: Ralph Lauren raises fiscal 2027 outlook
stories.summary: Ralph Lauren has raised its fiscal 2027 revenue growth outlook following strong second-quarter demand and premium-led selling. Asia led regional growth with a 10 percent increase. The company continues to invest in its brand-elevation strategy, focusing on products, customer experiences and global distribution.
